audit_basis: Independent read-only audit of the current DualSPHysics source tree and the materialized F9 r001 Definition. No GenCase, BI4/native preflight, solver, GPU, queue, registry, ledger, denominator, or training operation was performed.

provenance_path_audit.impact: The v1 receipts cite an absent vendor/official mirror, so their source-binding checks cannot be independently rerun from this checkout. The v2 receipt binds the canonical root source paths instead; this is a provenance defect, not runtime evidence.

nusselt_reference_and_local_projection.flux: q_prime=integral_0^h u_s(n)dn in m^2/s per unit span; Q=Ly*q_prime

runtime_mapping.source_rule: for dx>=MapRealSize.x, the runtime adds PeriXinc; for dx<0, it subtracts PeriXinc
runtime_mapping.interpretation: The sign maps the high-x/downstream copy back to the low-x/upstream copy while adding the positive z offset. The x width is not supplied by the XML parameter.

map_real_size_gate.reason: JSph computes MapRealSize from loaded BI4 map limits when present, otherwise from initial particle CasePosMin/CasePosMax plus periodic border handling. The XML pointmax and simulationdomain values do not constitute evidence of the loaded MapRealSize.x.
map_real_size_gate.admission_requirement: Do not claim MapRealSize.x=0.24 until a target-specific BI4 header or native startup/domain receipt records MapPosMax.x-MapPosMin.x=0.24 within the declared tolerance.

frozen_time_contract.note: The XML contains these values and 5.0/0.01+1=501. No output row receipt exists, and this audit does not create one.

local_coordinate_and_velocity_components.required_coordinate_origin: bottom-plane origin at x=0,z=0 for the anchor cell

pressure.blocking_detail: The contract does not bind the pressure channel convention (absolute pressure versus DualSPHysics native/gauge EOS pressure) or state whether p_atm is removed before the L2 comparison.
pressure.required_static_closure: Declare one pressure convention and bind the parser and reference array to it before admission.

velocity_gates.blocking_detail: The candidate states that velocity gates use U_ref but does not bind an implementation that projects native velocity into u_s/u_n/u_y or proves that Mach, normal-velocity and spanwise-RMS denominators use the case-specific U_ref.
velocity_gates.required_static_closure: Add a versioned F9 metric-parser contract or receipt naming the fields, projections, denominators and finite-value/exclusion handling.

surface_height.declared_reference: local n after subtracting theoretical plane n=h and time-window mean
surface_height.blocking_detail: Mean surface-height bias and demeaned RMS are named separately, but the surface-particle/interface selection, per-frame estimator, time-window aggregation, and sign convention are not bound to an implementation.
surface_height.required_static_closure: Freeze the interface estimator and separately compute signed mean bias and demeaned RMS over the same fixed denominator.

profile_and_flux.declared_reference: 64 fixed midpoint samples in n and q_prime integral of u_s
profile_and_flux.blocking_detail: The Definition contract describes the reference but no F9-specific parser/receipt is present in the current worktree to establish interpolation, particle weighting, periodic image handling, or excluded-particle policy.
profile_and_flux.required_static_closure: Bind an F9 parser schema and a static self-check before any qualification execution.

definition_revision_decision.reason: The r001 XML has a statically consistent geometry and frozen parameters, but the v1 contract incorrectly treats the requested Lx as the runtime periodic x width and overstates metric/parser closure. A contract revision is required now; a new XML case revision should be created only if the target-specific map receipt or the frozen metric semantics require changing the Definition.
definition_revision_decision.r002_xml_trigger: MapRealSize.x cannot be made 0.24 with the current materialized input, or any Definition/geometry/parameter change is needed to satisfy the corrected contract.

required_next_static_artifacts: A target-specific map/domain receipt that reports BI4 MapPosMin/MapPosMax and MapRealSize.x.
A versioned F9 metric-parser contract covering local coordinates, u_s/u_n/u_y, pressure convention, U_ref denominators, surface estimator, separate mean bias/RMS, profile bins and flux.
Fresh hashes for the corrected candidate, Definition and contract after any static change.

evidence.role: superseded static contract; retained for history
periodic parameter precedence, map loading, MapRealSize and runtime periodic sign
